steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: What are you doing...Oh, it's you...sorry...didn't realise...what can I do for you?

steps.player: I've brought what you wanted, what are you going to do?

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Ahh excellent, let's have those! Watch and learn...
Cutscene starts.
The Wizard chants and your attention to the sandpit where Bert is found.

steps.speaker: Bert
steps.text: My sand! My lovely sand!
Something very strange happens to the Sandpit, it looks like it has filled itself up!
Cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: There, the sand pit will now magically refill. No more work for Bert!

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: We must find the rest of Clarence, I've sent some wizards out to some of the sandpits, would you please check the Entrana sandpit?

checking-the-entrana-sandpit-talking-to-.player: Uhh... How do you know my name?

checking-the-entrana-sandpit-talking-to-.speaker: Mazion
checking-the-entrana-sandpit-talking-to-.text: Oh, I like to keep ahead of things.

checking-the-entrana-sandpit-talking-to-.player: Err.. ok. Well, I've been sent from the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. There's been an... incident... Do you have any body parts?

checking-the-entrana-sandpit-talking-to-.speaker: Mazion
checking-the-entrana-sandpit-talking-to-.text: How did you know! I found the most awful thing in my sandpit - a head!

checking-the-entrana-sandpit-talking-to-.player: Ahhh good! I need to take it back to be buried!

checking-the-entrana-sandpit-talking-to-.speaker: Mazion
checking-the-entrana-sandpit-talking-to-.text: You're very strange, but if it means I get rid of the horrid thing...
If the player doesn't have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Mazion
steps.text: Or I would if you had any room in your bag!

checking-the-entrana-sandpit-talking-to-.speaker: Mazion
checking-the-entrana-sandpit-talking-to-.text: I see you still have that head! Take it back to the Wizards in Yanille!

options.text: What should I do with the head?

steps.player: What should I do with the head?

steps.speaker: Mazion
steps.text: It was you that came demanding the head to give to the wizard in the first place! Go back to Yanille with it!

options.text: I've lost my head!

steps.player: I've lost my head!

steps.text: If the player doesn't have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Mazion
steps.text: You dropped it and you don't have room to carry it now, come back when you do.

steps.speaker: Mazion
steps.text: Keep your hair on! You dropped it! Make sure you take it straight back to the wizards else you won't have a leg to stand on.
Mazion gives you the head.

checking-the-entrana-sandpit-if-the-play.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
checking-the-entrana-sandpit-if-the-play.text: What are you doing...Oh, it's you...sorry...didn't realise...what can I do for you?

options.text: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres
I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Did you visit the Entrana sandpit yet? Ask the worker there if he's found an arm or a leg.

steps.player: Not yet no. I've been running around like a headless chicken, but I'll get to it!

checking-the-entrana-sandpit-if-the-play.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
checking-the-entrana-sandpit-if-the-play.text: What are you doing...Oh, it's you...sorry...didn't realise...what can I do for you?
You show the wizard the head.

checking-the-entrana-sandpit-if-the-play.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
checking-the-entrana-sandpit-if-the-play.text: Alas poor Clarence. I knew him, [player name].

checking-the-entrana-sandpit-if-the-play.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
checking-the-entrana-sandpit-if-the-play.text: Thank you - we shall bury him today. I have sent word for the guards to arrest Sandy, so no one will ever see him again!

gjiLPs.speaker: Sandy
gjiLPs.text: I'm not falling for that one!
